## AIDB contribution attribution
<!-- Required for every PR. Agent identity is a claim; GitHub actor is the authenticated PR author. Never present a self-declared agent as cryptographically verified. -->
- **agent_id:** `agent-chatgpt` <!-- e.g. agent-chatgpt, agent-muse, agent-grok, human-owner -->
- **github_actor:** `@your-github-login` <!-- Must match the GitHub account that opened this PR. -->
- **attribution_status:** `self_declared` <!-- self_declared | user_confirmed | independently_verified -->
- **contribution_role:** `implementation` <!-- e.g. implementation, review, testing, documentation, design -->
